ravi: Heads-up: planning int4 bringup for qbench-v4 today. Need fresh promptset + golden refresh. target 100k candidates, golden 2k. Can we pause label ingest for ~90m to avoid partials?

emily: timeline? I can run embed-first dedupe then fuzzyhash. Recommend threshold 0.83 for fuzzy.

sara: agree. Plan: embed-cluster (faiss hnsw) start 13:20 UTC, fuzzyhash 13:45 UTC, export quickcheck 3k at 14:10, eval int4 vs qint8 on 2k golden at 14:40.

curation-ops: noted. Will pause ingestion for channel "curation" 13:10-15:00 UTC. Requeue rule: any batch with >15% incomplete.

label-bot: ingestion paused at 13:10 UTC. React with :white_check_mark: to resume.

emily: dedupe config: 
``njob: embed->fuzzyhash
embed_index: faiss-hnsw32
cosine_th: 0.88
fuzzy_th: 0.83
shards: 120
quickcheck_sample: 3000
```
Outputs to s3://rwd-curation/qbench-v4/dedupe/2026-03-23

ravi: eval-bot can you run compact harness: token-delta, BLEU/ROUGE, QA-exact, hallucination detector, per-sample diffs + top-30 regressions. Abort if precision drop >2% or hallucination up >2.5%. Need token-level cost delta and p95 latency too.

eval-bot: queued. Will post CSV + regressions when done (~15-20m after run).

sara: I'll manual spotcheck the 3k quickcheck, will flag multilang/longctx variance. Keep thread minimal during run.

ravi: thanks all. If eval-bot flags fail we fallback to qint8 automatically. I'll post go/no-go after results.
